rows: Inhibits pyridoxal kinase, causing functional PLP deficiency and peripheral neuropathy; prevent with pyridoxine
DHFR inhibition impairs THF synthesis, producing megaloblastic anemia; rescue with leucovorin (folinic acid, which bypasses DHFR)
Thymidylate synthase inhibition impairs dUMP-to-dTMP conversion; functionally mimics folate deficiency at the DNA synthesis step
Impair folate absorption and metabolism, producing megaloblastic anemia
Reduce gastric acid, impairing proteolytic release of food-bound B12
Reduces ileal B12 absorption; monitor B12 with long-term use
dTMP = deoxythymidine monophosphate; DHFR = dihydrofolate reductase; dUMP = deoxyuridine monophosphate; PLP = pyridoxal phosphate; PPI = proton pump inhibitor; THF = tetrahydrofolate.
